abstract: There is a cytotoxic activity in blastocele fluid that kills embryonal carcinoma cells with trophectodermal potential but spares those with embryonic potential. This activity is present when programmed cell death occurs in the inner cell mass (ICM), and the ICM loses its trophectodermal potential. Because of the paucity of blastocele fluid, cystic embryoid bodies of embryonal carcinoma C44 were examined ultrastructurally and in tissue culture to determine if they corresponded to late blastocysts and if their fluid corresponded to blastocele fluid. No trophectoderm was demonstrated in the embryoid bodies, but embryonal carcinoma and endoderm were present, leading to the conclusion that the embryonal carcinoma corresponded to late ICM that had expressed endodermal potential. As a result the cyst fluid might have contained the toxic activity of blastocele fluid. The cyst fluid of C44 embryoid bodies did contain a soluble, low-molecular-weight, cytotoxic activity that preferentially killed embryonal carcinoma cells with trophectodermal potential while sparing those with embryonic potential. Enough of this fluid was available to determine the chemical nature of this toxic activity.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌細胞C44の嚢胞性胚様体を、胞胚腔液に対応するかどうか、超微細構造と組織培養で検討した。胚様体には栄養外胚葉は認められなかったが、胎児性癌と内胚葉が存在していた。このことから、胎児性癌は内部細胞塊の後期に内胚葉の分化能を発現したものに相当すると結論づけられた。したがって、嚢胞液が胞胚腔液の毒性活性を含んでいる可能性がある。C44胚様体の嚢胞液には、可溶性で低分子量の細胞傷害活性があり、栄養外胚葉の分化能を持つ胎児性癌細胞を選択的に殺傷し、胚性の分化能を持つものは温存した。この毒性活性の化学的性質を決定するのに十分な量の液が得られた。
